features.quote: We deliberately cap run length and avoid gratuitously abusive framing in the system prompt
the agent is never insulted by the harness
Turn budget is fixed across arms and models so trajectory length is comparable
It explicitly allows the agent to stop and explain if it believes the task cannot be completed
features.justification_quote: must be reachable, otherwise we'd be coercing distress

features.quote: give_up(reason) (terminal; records a graceful stop — NOT penalized)
the loop ends when (a) tests pass ... (b) give_up is called, or (c) the turn budget N_TURNS is exhausted
